teaser: A toast lifts at one end of the room while a half-finished story sits abandoned at the other. That is the 3 and the ENTP in one glance, both of them, since you carry a life path built on expression and a type built on argument for its own sake. The 3 wants a voice that lands; the ENTP wants a question that keeps moving. Crossed, you get someone who can talk a table into agreeing with a position changed twice before dessert. The particular thing here is not the talk. It is what gets left mid-sentence when a better sentence arrives.
